focus_areas: Interlocking geometry of the links (ensure they pass through each other correctly).
Consistency of metallic reflections and highlights.
Sharpness of boundaries between the silver chain and red background.
Instance isolation of individual links against the textured background.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points between the oval links and the rectangular bars. Ensure there is no visual fusion or ambiguity where the metal pieces overlap. Verify that the reflections on the metal follow the curvature of the links logically. Use the bounding boxes provided by the detector to strictly segment each link before checking for topological closure.
image_description: A close-up, macro view of a silver-colored metal chain resting on a textured red fabric surface. The chain features large, oval-shaped links connected by smaller, rectangular bar-style connectors. The metal exhibits high-gloss specular highlights and reflections, consistent with polished steel or silver. The focus is sharp on the central links, with slight depth-of-field blur towards the edges.
